gloss: putting into writing; documenting; converting into written form

definitions.gloss: putting into writing; documenting; converting into written form
definitions.explanation: The act of expressing ideas, rules, or information in written form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文章化|ぶんしょうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To put the meeting's contents into writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{口頭|こうとう}→口頭：11892_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文章化|ぶんしょうか}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おいた⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to put verbal agreements into writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗黙|あんもく}→暗黙：12876_anmoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文章化|ぶんしょうか}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{共有|きょうゆう}した→共有する：19639_kyouyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: We documented the unwritten rules and shared them with everyone.

notes:
Combines ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧ (writing/text) and ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation/conversion). The ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ suffix is highly productive and creates verbs meaning "to convert to" or "to make into." {文章化|ぶんしょうか} is commonly used in business and organizational contexts when formalizing rules, procedures, or agreements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文章化|ぶんしょうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put into writing, to document
- ⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文章化|ぶんしょうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to document rules
- {文章化|ぶんしょうか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧: documented rules

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文書化|ぶんしょか}→文書化：23170_bunshoka⟧: documentation — very close synonym, slightly more formal/bureaucratic
- {書面化|しょめんか}: putting into written form — emphasizes the official document
- ⟦{言語化|げんごか}→言語化：20608_gengoka⟧: verbalization — putting thoughts into words (spoken or written)
